newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds ease with Bonos in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds ease with Bonos in dull trade.

text.p: Portuguese bonds eased in sympathy with Bonos in dull trade as some benchmark bonds were suspended for coupon payments.
Dealers said yield spreads between three- and five-year bonds and Bonos widened amid signs rates could edge higher in Portugal despite encouraging January inflation data.
The escudo came under slight selling pressure and stood at 100.56/59 per mark at 1742 GMT.
